cases.mechanism_detail: An ~6-kb LINE-1 insertion within SLCO1B3 intron 6 (c.481+22insLINE-1) was confirmed by gel electrophoresis in all four Chinese Rotor syndrome children, together with SLCO1B1 variants (digenic disease); RNA effect not studied.
cases.quote: gel electrophoresis has confirmed the existence of the LINE-1 insertional variant of about 6 kb within intron 6 of the SLCO1B3 gene in all children.
